items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEyMDUzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fb89206b5263dbd95b0c2c4f82523a97b1aff0d5/home%20wca%20ic%2026.png) # Selamat Datang di Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026! Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 merupakan kejuaraan nasional speedcubing yang akan diadakan di Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. Kompetisi ini akan diadakan selama tiga hari dan terbuka untuk umum. Setiap peserta diharapkan untuk memerhatikan time limit dan cut-off untuk setiap event karena diatur lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya. Setiap peserta wajib hadir 15 menit sebelum event yang diikuti dimulai. Jika peserta terlambat, maka panitia berhak mendiskualifikasi peserta tersebut. **Pendaftaran on the spot TIDAK AKAN DITERIMA.** **Catatan Penting:** Terdapat batasan limit peserta untuk Event berikut: * 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (terbatas untuk 24 pendaftar pertama) * 4x4x4 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama) * 5x5x5 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama) * 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (terbatas untuk 20 pendaftar pertama) Akan ada **3 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini: * **Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori * **Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan * **Kategori Anak (Indonesia)** - Top 3 pemenang kompetisi untuk peserta berkewarganegaraan Indonesia berusia di bawah 13 tahun (per 01 November 2026) untuk event 3x3x3 Dengan mendaftar, peserta dan pendamping setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi atau kerusakan/kehilangan barang selama acara berlangsung. Peserta akan mendapatkan Lanyard dan Name Tag. Pastikan memantau jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka jadwal dapat berubah tergantung jumlah pendaftar tiap event. Silakan melakukan registrasi di laman [daftar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) dan konfirmasi di form ini: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7. Jika Anda tidak dapat mengakses form tersebut, silakan mengirimkan bukti pembayaran registrasi ke email ini: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). Dalam email tersebut, mohon tuliskan nama lengkap, WCA ID (jika Anda memilikinya), tanggal lahir, daftar event yang diikuti, dan bukti pembayaran. ----------------------- # Welcome to Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026! Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 is the national speedcubing championship that will be held at Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. The competition will take place over three days and is open to the public. All competitors are expected to pay close attention to the time limit and cut-off for each event, as they are set more strictly than in a typical competition. All competitors must arrive 15 minutes before the event starts. If the competitor is late, the competitor will be disqualified. **On the Spot registration WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.** **Important Notes:** There are competitor limits for the following events: * 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (limited to the first 24 registered competitors) * 4x4x4 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors) * 5x5x5 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors) * 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (limited to the first 20 registered competitors) There will be **3 categories of winners** in this competition: * **Indonesian Category** - The top 3 Indonesian competitors in each event * **Open Category** - The top 3 competitors overall, regardless of nationality * **Kids Category (Indonesia)** - Top 3 winners of the competition among Indonesian citizens under 13 years of age (as of 01 November 2026) in the 3x3x3 event By registering, competitors and their guests acknowledge that the organizers, the NSA, and the WCA are not responsible for any personal injury or any loss of or damage to personal belongings during the event. All competitors will receive a Lanyard and a Name Tag. Please check the competition schedule regularly during the registration period, as it may change depending on the number of registrations for each event. Please register on the [register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) page and confirm your registration by completing this form: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7. If you cannot access the form, please submit your proof of payment for the registration to this email: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). In the email, please write your full name, WCA ID (if you have it), date of birth, list of events, and the proof of payment.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAxNzc1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2d27809f1784d7222b898a07b6f26a4355886a37/image.png) # Português ​ A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. ​ Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. ​ **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. ​ **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. **Não haverá tutorial para competidores novatos no dia da competição** ​ As inscrições custam R$ 30,00 (trinta reais) a serem pagos antes do campeonato. A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail). ​ O pagamento da inscrição dá direito a um acompanhante. Convidados e espectadores, inclusive os responsáveis por menores de 18 anos, devem pagar uma taxa de R$ 10,00 (dez reais) para poderem ingressar no evento. ​ Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 40,00 (quarenta reais), caso haja vagas. ​ Acompanhantes e espectadores poderão comprar seu ingresso no dia pelo valor de R$ 15,00 (vinte reais), caso haja vagas. ​ **Estudantes do Colégio Integral terão desconto na inscrição, pagando uma taxa de R$ 15,00 (quinze reais) caso se inscrevam antes da competição e R$ 20,00 (vinte reais) caso se inscrevam no dia da competição.** ​ # English ​ Registration is open to any person, from any country. ​ To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. ​ **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. ​ **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. **No tutorial for newcomers will occur at the competition** ​ Registration costs R$30.00 (thirty Brazilian reais) to be paid in advance. Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof by e-mail, with all the information required). ​ Payment of registration fee guarantees the competitor a single companion. Guests and spectators, including the guardians of people under 18, must pay a fee of R$10.00 to enter the event. ​ On-site registrations will be accepted for R$40.00 (fourty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. ​ Guests and spectators can buy their tickets on the day for R$20.00 (twenty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. ​ **Colégio Integral students will have a descount. They will pay R$ 15.00 (fifteen brazilian reais) if they register prior to the competition and R$ 20.00 (twenty brazilian reais) if they register on the spot.**

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjQ3NzUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b83885f0ca3e638334b1142605be9fcc75373ce5/newcm.png) (SRB) **Irig Newcommer Day 2025** je dvadeset i četvrto po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. Ovo takmičenje učestvuje u zvaničnom **WCA Mesecu Novih Takmičara 2025**. Proces registracije obezbeđuje 50% mesta za nove takmičare. Novi takmičari su oni koji još nemaju WCA ID ili imaju WCA ID iz 2025. godine. Takmičari koji imaju WCA ID iz 2024. godine ili ranije smatraju se povratnicima. Svi takmičari i dalje moraju ispuniti sve zahteve za prijavu kako bi njihova prijava bila smatrana potpunom. **Prijave će se prihvatati na sledeći način:** * 50% mesta, određenih ograničenjem broja takmičara, obezbeđeno je za nove takmičare. * Ako se više od 50% novih takmičara prijavi pre nego što se preostalih 50% mesta popuni povratnicima, dalja prijava će se prihvatati uobičajenim redosledom za nove takmičare i povratnike istovremeno. * Ako mesta obezbeđena za nove takmičare ne popune novi takmičari dve nedelje pre zatvaranja registracija, preostala mesta, do ograničenja broja takmičara, biće dodeljena prijavljenim povratnicima. ------------------------ (ENG) **Irig Newcommer Day 2025** is the 24th speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. This competition is participating in the official **WCA Newcomer Month 2025**. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** * 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUxNzQ1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--17016ac1ed61251cf2a6d4d6760c727b6f917f7b/25%20mesas%20100%20cadeiras.png) Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. - Ao se inscrever você está autorizando o uso de imagem para divulgações sobre o campeonato. - Só serão aceitas inscrições no local para a modalidade 3x3. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! Tips: - Arrive at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the event you will be participating in; - The cube you will be competing with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, so take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of magic cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organizing team and delegates. - By registering, you are authorizing the use of your image for publicity about the competition. - Only on-site registrations will be accepted for the 3x3 event. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we always have room for new cubers. Have fun!

items.information: 🇧🇷 Bem-vindos ao primeiro campeonato sediado em Itajaí ! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo.https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8 Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. 🇺🇸 Welcome to the first competition in Itajaí! Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at this video. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8 Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition. We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcElrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4be3c11536038145829dbcba17ca15bdea04981e/imagen.png) # 🇺🇾 Hay un límite de 10 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsBLDTimeOpen2023#28208-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsBLDTimeOpen2023#28209-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia. Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA. # 🇬🇧 Competitor limit: 10. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsBLDTimeOpen2023#28208-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsBLDTimeOpen2023#28209-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Competitors must bring their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * It is important to read all the information available in the competition website. Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEwMTIwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--82167337bca974bb92ecb210a31ed309c9633397/photo_2026-08-03_11-44-49.jpg)Змагання зі швидкісного складання кубика Рубіка на підтримку України 🇺🇦 Запрошуємо всіх охочих взяти участь у змаганнях зі швидкісного складання кубика Рубіка — події, яка об'єднає любителів спідкубінгу заради доброї справи. Це не лише можливість перевірити свої навички, позмагатися з найсильнішими учасниками та провести час у дружній атмосфері, а й підтримати Україну. Разом ми доводимо, що кожен рух має значення, а єдність робить нас сильнішими. Уся актуальна інформація щодо реєстрації, розкладу, правил, можливих змін та інших організаційних питань публікуватиметься в Telegram-групі заходу. Складай швидко. Підтримуй Україну. Разом до перемоги! 💙💛 Speed ​​​​Rubik's Cube Competition in Support of Ukraine 🇺🇦 We invite everyone who wants to take part in the speed Rubik's Cube competition - an event that will unite speedcubing enthusiasts for a good cause. This is not only an opportunity to test your skills, compete with the strongest participants and spend time in a friendly atmosphere, but also to support Ukraine. Together we prove that every move matters, and unity makes us stronger. All relevant information regarding registration, schedule, rules, possible changes and other organizational issues will be published in the Telegram group of the event. Solve it quickly. Support Ukraine. Together to victory! 💙💛

items.information: #日本一を決めよう。 2026年度の**3x3x3最少手数 日本チャンピオン**を決める大会です。 ※こちらの大会では3x3x3 最少手数競技のみの開催となります。 その他の競技については、別日に開催します。こちらよりお申し込みください。 [Japan Championship 2026] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/JapanChampionship2026) 主催: Japan Championship 2026 実行委員会 後援: 一般社団法人スピードキュービングジャパン 協力: 大阪キューブ会 / くるくる会 This competition will determine the **2026 Japan National Champion for 3x3 Fewest Moves**. **Important: Language Requirement** This competition is held to determine the National Champion of Japan. Please note that all proceedings, announcements, and interactions with judges will be conducted exclusively in Japanese. Please be advised that we cannot accommodate personal interpreters within the competition area. Organized by: Japan Championship 2026 Organizing Committee Supported by: Speedcubing Japan In cooperation with: Osaka Cube / Kurukuru Kai

Featuring official events in 2x2, 3x3, 6x6, 7x7, Skewb, and Pyraminx, this competition is perfect for both newcomers and seasoned competitors looking to set new personal bests. Join us for an action-packed summer showdown filled with speed, strategy, and community spirit!

items.information: The Jordan Fall Open 2021 is an official speedcubing competition of the World Cube Association (WCA). Speedcubing involves solving the 3x3x3 Cube or similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors, regardless of experience and skill, but time limits will be imposed in order to keep to the schedule and complete the days on time. No previous experience of WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA rules.

items.name: Jordan Nationals 2022
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbVVTIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--da65c4eb282d1958abc17166571c52cd38e471e3/Screenshot%202021-11-12%20124103%20(1).jpg) تفاصيل المسابقة :- المسابقة في قاعة في الطابق الأرضي في مدرسة الحكمة الثانوية للبنين، شارع الاستقلال، بالقرب من الاستقلال مول،. كما هو موضح في العنوان في الأعلى👆. يمكنك الدخول إلى القاعة من المدخل الخلفي، عند مكان تجمع حافلات المدرسة. يرجى العلم بأن المسابقة ستكون لمدة يومين و الايفنتات مقسمة على مدة يومين كما هو موضح في الجدول. ( في حال رغبتكم بالمشاركة في ايفنتات اليوم الثاني فقط يرجى العلم بأنه سيتم فتح التسجيل في كلا اليومين فلا داعي للحضور لمجرد التسجيل في اليوم الأول) حرصا على سلامتكم و اتباعا لاجراءات السلامة، يرجى إبراز شهادة المطعوم عند الدخول، أو إظهار سند أخضر، أو فحص pcr لمن هم فوق ١٢ سنة و شكرا. اذا كان لديك اي استفسار او سؤال عن تفاصيل المسابقة، يرجى التواصل من خلال الايميل في الأعلى، أو من خلال صفحة Jordan cubing community عبر تطبيق Instagram. Competition details: - The competition will be held in a hall on the ground floor of Al-Hikma Secondary School for Boys, Al-Istiklal Street, near Al-Istiklal Mall. As indicated in the title above. You can enter the hall from the back entrance, where the school buses gather. Please note that the competition will be for two days and the events are divided into two days as shown in the schedule . (If you want to participate in the events of the second day only, please note that registration will be opened on both days, so there is no need to attend just to register on the first day) For the sake of your safety and to follow safety procedures, please show the vaccination certificate upon entry, or show a green bond ( from Sanad app) , or a PCR test for people over 12 years old, thank you. If you have any questions about competition details, you can ask from the email shown up, or from ( Jordan cubing community) on Instagram app. https://www.instagram.com/jocubingcommunity/

items.information: Välkomna till Jukkasjärvi Midnight Sun 2024, den nordligaste kubtävlingen i Sverige någonsin! Организаторы не несут ответственности за утерю личных вещей. 2. Мы настоятельно рекомендуем использовать на головоломках отличительные отметки (Внутри кубика или под крышкой детальки) , по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец. ______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает, что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и папку СПАМ. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Байқау туралы барлық ақпарат пен жаңалықтар біздің instagram желісінде болады. 1.Жеке заттар жоғалуына ұйымдастырушылар жауапты емес. 2. Пазлдарда ерекше белгілерді пайдалануды ұсынамыз (текшенің ішінде немесе бөліктің мұқабасының астында), белгі арқылы иесі оларды оңай анықтауға мүмкіндік береді. __________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Төлемді төлегеннен кейін сіздің аты-жөніңіз сайтта пайда болады. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемеген болсаңыз, онда тіркеуден шамамен 1 апта бұрын және тіркеуді жаппас бұрын, сіз өзіңіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін жарнаны төлеу қажеттілігі туралы ескерту хат аласыз. Міндетті түрде Жәшік пен СПАМ қалтасын тексеріңіз. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемесеңіз, онда сіздің өтініміңіз қабылданбайды. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде). Жарыс күні қатысушыда өзімен бірге жеке басын куәландыратын құжат болуы қажет. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Please see our Instagram account (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). All information and news on the competition will be on our instagram. 1. The organizers are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings. 2. We strongly recommend using distinctive marks on the puzzles (Inside the cube or under the cover of the part), by which the owner can easily identify them. ________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you have not paid the fee, you will receive an email reminding you to pay the fee to confirm your participation approximately 1 week before and immediately before the registration closes. Be sure to check your inbox and SPAM folder. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but did not confirm it within 2 working days, immediately contact the organizers (excluding weekends). On the day of the competition, the participant must have an identity document with him.

items.information: Пожалуйста, смотрите наш Инстаграм аккаунт(https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Вся информация по соревнованиям будет в нашем инстаграме. ВНИМАНИЕ!!! 1. Участник не достигший 16 лет, обязательно должен быть в сопровождении совершеннолетнего. Родители, родственники или опекуны несовершеннолетнего участника СОГЛАШАЮТСЯ, с тем, что они несут полную и личную ответственность за безопасность несовершеннолетнего участника в период и на территории проведения соревнований. 2. Допуск участников в помещение будет производиться: - по приложению Ashyq согласно эпидемиологическим нормам действующим на момент проведения соревнований; - с соблюдением масочного режима (при себе иметь 5 масок на 1 день), - исключительно по предварительной регистрации, - при наличии документов удостоверяющих личность. 3. Участники должны быть задействованы в судействе, скрамблинге, и должны пройти регистрацию до 9:40 часов, не зависимо от времени участия в своих дисциплинах. 4. Организаторы не несут ответственности в случае отмены соревнований, в связи с ухудшением эпидемиологической ситуации. Взнос будет возвращен в полном объеме. 5. Подача заявки на участие и оплата взноса означает, что участник полностью ознакомлен и согласен с правилами проведения соревнований. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Please see the website(https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). All information about competition will be in our Instagram. ATTENTION!!! 1. Any participant under the age of 16 must be accompanied by an adult. Parents, relatives or guardians of a minor participant AGREE that they bear full and personal responsibility for the safety of a minor participant during and on the territory of the competition. 2. Admission of participants to the premises will be made: - according to the Ashyq application in accordance with the epidemiological standards in force at the time of the competition; - in compliance with the mask regime (have 5 masks for 1 day with you), - only by pre-registration, - in the presence of documents proving the identity. 3. Participants must be involved in judging, scrambling, and must register before 9:45 hours, regardless of the time of participation in their disciplines. 4. The organizers are not responsible in case of cancellation of the competition due to the deterioration of the epidemiological situation. The fee will be refunded in full. 5. Submission of an application for participation and payment of the fee means that the participant is fully acquainted with and agrees with the rules of the competition.

Головоломки используемые в соревнованиях должны иметь отличительные отметки, по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец (например: нацарапанные инициалы или имя с внутренней стороны съемной крышки) ====================================================== После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1-2 недели до соревнований вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и спам. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). В день соревнований участнику и гостю при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. For more info please visit our [VK Group](https://vk.com/ksfustkamenogorskcity2019). Before submitting the application, read the registration information. Registration with incorrect first and last name will not be accepted, please carefully check the entered data. Submitting an application and paying a participation fee or a guest / viewer entrance ticket means that you acquainted and agree with the rules of the championship If you have read the terms of registration and the terms of payment of the fee in the tab "How to pay / How to pay for participation", then you can proceed to registration. **ATTENTION!!! 1. If a participant under 18 years old attends the competition without adult, he must have written application from parents or legal guardians that they are responsible for their child. 2. Puzzles used in competitions must have distinctive marks by which the owner can easily identify them (for example, scratched initials or the name on the inside of the removable cover) ** After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you did not pay the fee, then approximately 1-2 weeks before the competition you will receive an email with a reminder to pay a fee to confirm your participation. Be sure to check your box and spam. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but it was not confirmed within 2 business days, contact the organizers immediately (not counting the weekend). On the day of the competition, the participant and the guest need to have an identity document.

items.name: Kalaallit Nunaat 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2syIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--421be8dcbd6a4e0e29893d46b60668a278a829ce/image.png) * This is the second speedcubing competition recognized by the WCA in Nuuk! * The competition happens on Sunday June 23rd but a workshop will happen on Saturday 22nd from 16 to 19. Join us for a good time with other cubers, to learn new techniques and be ready for timing yourself on Sunday afternoon! * The competition is a fun way to time yourself and have official results recognized by the World Cube Association! You will be called to do 5 timed solves, your best time and worst times are removed and your ranking is determined by the average of the 3 remaining times! All you need is to be able to solve the cube in less than 10 minutes, we will help you with this during the workshop! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1kyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--050293ccbaf021bc31fec3d8a961df60e1d36ac7/image.png) * Una Nuummi Speedcubing-imik unamminerup aappassaraa World Cube Association-imiit akuerisaq! * Unammineq sapaammi 23. juni ualikkut nal. 13:10-19:45 piumaarpoq, pinnginneranilu pikkorissarneq arfiningornermi 22. juni nal. 16:00 19:00 aamma sapaammi 23. juni nal. 12-13 ingerlanneqassalluni. Piffissami nuannersumi peqatigisigut, allanik aamma cubertartunik peqataasoqarumaarpoq. Periusinik nutaanik ilinniarit, imminullu piffissalersornissannut sapaammi. * Unamminermi nuannersumik imminut piffissalersussaatit inerniliussallu World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaasussaassallutik. Tallimariarlutit piffissalersussaatit, pitsaanerpaaq ajornerpaarlu peerpata sinneruttut pingasut inernerisa agguaqatigiisinnera unamminermi inissitsiternermi sumiinnersutit inissikkumaarlugu. Anguniagaq tassaaginnarpoq minutsit qulit iluanni terningip naammassisinnaanngornissaa. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2cyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3511d693f3962fa6f0a96bf67ebafa277e88e75e/image.png) * Dette er den anden speedcubing konkurrence som er anerkendt af World Cube Association i Nuuk! * Konkurrencen finder sted søndag den 23. juni om eftermiddagen kl.13:10-19:45 , før konkurrencen vil der være en workshop lørdag den 22. fra kl. 16-19 og søndag fra kl.12-13. Tag med os til en god tid sammen med andre cubers, for at lære nye teknikker og være klar til at time dig selv søndag eftermiddag. * Konkurrencen er en sjov måde at time dig selv og få officielle resultater anerkendt af World Cube Association! Du vil blive kaldt til at lave 5 tidsbestemte løsninger, din bedste tid og værste tider fjernes, og din placering bestemmes af gennemsnittet af de 3 resterende gange! Det eneste du skal bruge er at kunne løse kuben på under 10 minutter, det hjælper vi dig med under workshoppen!

items.name: Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024#48216-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024#48216-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: 5/27午前に行われるKanazawa Challenge Spring AM 2023(**本大会 / 以下、AM大会**) と同日午後に行われる[Kanazawa Challenge Spring PM 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KanazawaChallengeSpringPM2023) (以下、PM大会) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。 ### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 なお、AM大会とPM大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。 **AM大会: 3x3x3 キューブ / 2x2x2 キューブ** PM大会: 3x3x3 キューブ / 4x4x4 キューブ 会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**同伴申請は、競技参加者１名につき１名**に制限しています。 **競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴は受け付けておりません。** また、同伴希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先とし、 会場の許容人数を超える方に関しては別室にて待機をお願いする場合があります。 なお、見学者は原則として受け入れません。 Kanazawa Challenge Spring AM 2023 (**This competition, AM**) and [Kanazawa Challenge Spring PM 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KanazawaChallengeSpringPM2023) (PM) are WCA Series Competitions. ### You can register either of these series competitions. If you register for multiple competitions, only the earliest one will be received, and the others will be rejected. Please make sure that the events for A and B are different. **AM: 3x3x3 Cube / 2x2x2 Cube** PM: 3x3x3 Cube / 4x4x4 Cube **Only the companions of competitors are allowed to enter the venue as spectators.** Being mindful of space, we can only accept requests of **1 companion at MAX per competitor.** If the number of requests would become too many, a certain prioritization might be applied. (Ex. Guardians for minors) In principle, no visitors will be accepted.

items.name: Kanonkuben 2024
items.information: Välkomna till Kanonkuben 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi tackar Ung i Strängnäs som hjälpt till med lokalen! Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Kanonkuben 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. Thank you to "Ung i Strängnäs" who are helping with the venue! We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

items.information: 関西定例大会夏2019内の3×3×3第一ラウンドで、年齢別「こども大会」（小学生以下）および「マスターズ大会」（35歳以上）を併催します。 対象年齢内での順位を決め、第一ラウンド終了後に表彰を行います(WCA上の入賞とは異なります)。 第一ラウンドで「こども大会」「マスターズ大会」に参加していても、全年齢含めての順位が上位であればそのまま第二ラウンドに進むことができます。 During the first round of 3x3x3 at the Kansai Summer 2019, we will also hold an age-specific “Juniors Competition” (competitors less than primary school children) and "Masters Competition" (competitors of 35 years of age or older). At the end of this first round, the rankings for each age category will be determined, and awards will be given. These awards are separated from the actual WCA competition. Even if you join the “Juniors Competition” or the “Masters Competiton” in the first round, you can continue to the second round if your ranking within all participants allows it.

items.name: Katerini Beach Open 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbFZ1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--832ba1051dbfb958a61c53d310fdebb0b82e9442/image.png) Συνεχίζουμε τη συναρπαστική σειρά των διαγωνισμών για το 2024 με το 'Katerini Beach Open 2024', τον 4ο διαγωνισμό της χρονιάς. Αυτή τη φορά πηγαίνουμε βόρεια, στην ξακουστή παραλία της Κατερίνης, δίπλα στο κύμα! Στο συνεδριακό κέντρο του ξενοδοχείου Mediterranean Village θα συναντηθούμε με την φιλοδοξία να πραγματοποιηθεί ένα από τα μεγαλύτερα αν όχι το μεγαλύτερο έως τώρα OPEN της Ελλάδας! Σε ένα μοναδικό Σαββατοκύριακο, με άρωμα από το επερχόμενο ελληνικό καλοκαίρι, όλοι οι συμμετέχοντες θα απολαύσουν το πάθος τους για το cubing σε έναν ιδανικό προορισμό. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας (και τα μαγιό σας) και ελάτε να γιορτάσουμε μαζί την αγάπη για το cubing σε ένα αμιγώς ελληνικό τοπίο! Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε όλες τις καρτέλες για να βρείτε τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) We continue the exciting series of competitions for 2024 with the 'Katerini Beach Open 2024', the 4th competition of the year. This time we go north, to the famous beach of Katerini, by the sea! In the conference center of the Mediterranean Village hotel & SPA we will meet again with the ambition to hold one of the biggest, if not the biggest, OPEN in Greece! In a unique weekend, with the aroma of the upcoming Greek summer, all participants will enjoy their passion for cubing in an ideal destination. Grab your cubes (and your swimsuits) and come celebrate the love of cubing together in a purely Greek landscape! Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.name: Kazakhstan Open 2017
items.information: Максимум один гость на одного участника. Мы сократили количество дисциплин, чтобы мы могли принять больше участников ======= Пожалуйста, напишите свое имя и фамилию на кириллице. Вы можете внести регистрационный взнос в день проведения конкурса. ======= Бұл Қазақстандағы алғашқы WCA байқауы. Біз осы жарыстың артынан көп болады деген үміттеміз. Конкурстың басталуына дейін 1-2 апта бұрын сіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін электронды хат аласыз. Пошта жәшігіңізді және спамды жіберетін уақытты тексеріңіз. Егер сіз растамасаңыз, онда сіз бәсекелестердің тізімінен аластатыласыз. ====== Это первый конкурс WCA в Казахстане. Мы надеемся, что после этого конкурса последует еще много. Примерно за 1-2 недели до конкурса вы получите электронное письмо, чтобы подтвердить свое участие. Обязательно проверяйте свой почтовый ящик и спам. Если вы не подтвердите, то вы удалитесь из списка конкурсантов. ====== This is the first WCA competition in Kazakhstan. We hope after this competition many more will follow. Around 1-2 weeks before the competition you will receive an email to confirm your participation. Please make sure to check your mailbox and spam box around that time. If you do not confirm, then you will removed from the list of competitors.

items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025! ### This competition is open to everyone to compete in, regardless of nationality or experience level. [![Kewbz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1Y0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3fb56d1f073b7544d2cf011acfe92e29f237f69/Kewbz_Logo.png)](https://ukspeedcubes.co.uk/) ![Scottish Championship Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQyNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c4ab4fd8fb34605abb30bab45291a8318375f865/Scottish%20Champs%20Logo.png) #### New Competitors: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52598-faq) and the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52599-important-information) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. #### Free T-Shirt: By registering and attending Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025, you'll receive a free Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025 T-shirt! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size. A sizing guide is provided in the** [T-Shirt tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52603-t-shirt-sizes). #### Qualifications: **3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Skewb, Pyraminx, and 3x3 One-Handed do not have any qualification requirements and remain open to everyone, including new competitors, to compete in**. Other events have qualification requirements in place. If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025/#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by May 19th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. #### Spectators and Guests: Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There is no need to pre-book. #### Prizes: As this is the Kewbz Scottish Championship, **only competitors who are Scottish** (please see the [prizes eligiblity tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#53036-prizes-eligibility) for further details) **will be eligible for prizes**. The competition remains open for competitors of all nationalities and UK regions to compete. #### Podium Positions: If fewer than three Scottish competitors proceed to the final of an event, any remaining podium positions will be determined using the results of the highest ranked Scottish competitors in the previous round. #### Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025: The Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025 will be held separately on Saturday 24th May in Glasgow. This competition will host 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3 Fewest Moves. Podiummers at the Blind Off will be crowned at Kewbz Scottish Championship. #### Invitation Letters: Should you need a Visa invitation letter, or a note from us to help authorise time off school, please [get in touch](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition). #### Media Enquiries: Please [contact us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition) for all media enquiries.

items.name: Kewbz UK Championship 2022
items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz UK Championship 2022! ### This year's UK National Championship ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Spectators and Guests](#22468-spectators-and-guests) tab. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size. **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only, the fee must be paid at the competition. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements in an official WCA competition by *17th October 2022*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the **Events** tab to see these requirements. Please note that **new competitors can only compete in 3x3, 2x2, Skewb and Pyraminx**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2022) on 22nd October instead. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2022. We will be taking videos and photographs of the competition and the environment for our social media pages and website. Media persons will also be in attendance. By attending the competition as a competitor or a guest, you are accepting that you may be filmed or photographed for these purposes. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. [![Kewbz](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/679033331912015892/1005532291797352509/RGB_FINAL_UKC_2022_LOGO_FOR_SCREENS.png)](https://kewbz.co.uk)

There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish! **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending the Kewbz UK Championship 2026, you'll receive a Kewbz UK Championship 2026 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Newcomers:** This competition is open to first-time competitors, who will only be able to compete in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, and 3x3 One-Handed. If you would like to attempt to qualify for other events, you must do so another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2026#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 16th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **there are no qualifications for 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, or 3x3 One-Handed.** **Final Round Advancements:** The top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals for all events. In 3x3, any non-UK competitors faster than the 8th UK competitor will compete together, before UK competitors face off in seeded pairs. In other events, all 16 finalists will compete together, with the [top 8 UK competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p2b) being joined by the 8 remaining best competitors from any region. **Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind:** These events will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for these events, you must compete at the [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2026) or the [Kewbz UK Blindfolded Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKBLDChampionship2026). The podium winners of these competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2026. **Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. **Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. --------------------------------------------------------------- Registration is open to all, of all nationalities. Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few.

items.information: **German** Willkommen zurück beim Zauberwürfel Wettbewerb in Köln! Zum zweiten Mal finden die Kölner Kubing statt. Seid dabei, knackt eure Rekorde, egal ob Einsteiger oder Profi – habt Spaß an diesem Turnier. Schnappt euch euren Würfel und seid Teil dieses einzigartigen Events! **English** Welcome back to the Rubik's Cube competition in Cologne! The Kölner Kubing is taking place for the second time. Be there, break your records, whether you are a beginner or a pro - have fun at this tournament. Grab your cube and be part of this unique event!

items.name: Kölner Kubing 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDIwOTUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7a09c07e7df2145faa8d4f7db972b8360df44444/KK25_New.png) ##### **German** Willkommen zurück beim Zauberwürfel Wettbewerb in Köln! Zum dritten Mal findet Kölner Kubing statt. Seid dabei, knackt eure Rekorde, egal ob Einsteiger oder Profi – habt Spaß an diesem Turnier. Schnappt euch euren Würfel und seid Teil dieses einzigartigen Events! **Wichtig!** Bei den letzten Competitions von Köln hatten wir in den ersten 5 Minuten über 150 Anmeldungen. Sorgt bitte dafür, dass ihr die Teilnahmegebühr **vor** der Online-Anmeldung bezahlt. Wenn Ihr überweisen müsst, macht das bitte 2-3 Tage vorher, damit die Zahlung rechtzeitig bei uns ankommt. Wir gehen wieder davon aus, dass auch Kölner Kubing 2025 innerhalb weniger Minuten voll sein wird! **English** Welcome back to the Rubik's Cube competition in Cologne! Kölner Kubing is taking place for the third time. Be there, break your records, whether you are a beginner or a pro - have fun at this tournament. Grab your cube and be part of this unique event! **Important!** In the last competitions in Cologne we had over 150 registrations in the first 5 minutes. Please make sure that you pay the entry fee **before** you register online. If you have to pay by bank transfer, please do so 2-3 days in advance so that we receive the payment in time. We assume that Kölner Kubing 2025 will again be full within a few minutes!

items.name: KoprCube 2022
items.information: První oficiální soutěž v Kopřivnici. First official competition in Koprivnice. Cze: Soutěž proběhne v sobotu. Kdo bude mít zájem dojet už v pátek kvůli vzdálenosti nebo jen zkrátka kvůli lidem, akci, tréninku, není problém, od 18 h budou brány DDM otevřeny. S sebou je nutné si tak vzít karimatku a spacák. Jídlo si účastníci zajišťují sami. 150 m Albert, vietnamské bistro, restaurace… Kontakt: Rezi 602 724 115, rezi@zaobzor.cz Eng: Competition will start on Saturday morning. If you want, you can arrive at Friday evening at 6 pm or later. We will be here, preparing the venue. Take your sleeping bag and mat, if you want spend the night here. It is for free. Food is up to you. There is supermarket Albert 150m from here, Vietnamese bistro, restaurants in the centre of the city and more. Contact: Rezi +420 602 724 115, rezi@zaobzor.cz

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYwMTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--590d632186b67d440422c5a58d28b228cf84e84a/%E1%84%89%E1%85%B3%E1%84%8F%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%AB%E1%84%89%E1%85%A3%E1%86%BA%202024-12-25%2000.10.29.png) 이 대회는 WCA Newcomer Month 2025의 일환입니다. 참가자 정원의 50%는 첫 참가자에게 배정됩니다. 이 때 첫 참가자란, WCA ID가 없거나 WCA ID가 2025로 시작하는 분들입니다. 기존 참가자(첫 참가자가 아닌 분)는 WCA ID가 2024 또는 그 이전의 숫자로 시작하는 분들입니다. 모든 참가자는 모든 등록 요건을 충족해야 등록이 완료된 것으로 간주됩니다. 참가 신청은 다음 사항을 기준으로 수락됩니다: - 참가자 정원의 50%는 첫 참가자에게 배정됩니다. - 나머지 50%는 기존 참가자에게 배정됩니다. - 기존 참가자가 정원의 50%를 채우기 전에 첫 참가자가 정원의 50% 이상 등록하면, 배정된 50% 안에 선착순에 의해 들지 못한 첫 참가자는 기존 참가자와 구분 없이 선착순으로 수락됩니다. - 첫 참가자를 위한 자리가 대회 시작 2주 전 또는 참가 신청 기간 마감일이 되기 전에 모두 채워지지 않으면, 남은 자리는 기존 참가자들로부터 선착순으로 수락됩니다. --- This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: - 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. - Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. - If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. - If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. --- 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. --- Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.information: ### 시리즈별 대회장이 다릅니다. 주의하세요. ### A대회 : 세미나실 1 ### B, C대회 : 세미나실 3 ### 본 대회는 시리즈 대회의 일환으로, 시리즈 대회 중 하나의 대회에만 참가할 수 있습니다. 관련 안내 사항을 [시리즈 대회 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaQualifierDaeguA2024#43995-about-the-series-competitions)에서 확인 바랍니다. ### 대회 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대회 참가가 불가능합니다. ### 참가 확정 / 대기 명단은 3일 내로 갱신되니, 참가 신청 이후 명단에서 본인의 이름을 확인해 주시기를 바랍니다. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 참가비 납부는 [대회 신청 및 참가비 납부](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaQualifierDaeguA2024#43887-registration-and-payment-details) 탭을 눌러 확인해주세요. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. ___ ### Series competitions have different venues. Be careful. ### A Series : Seminar rooms 1 ### B, C Series : Seminar rooms 3 ### This competition is part of a series competitions, meaning that you can only participate in one competition of the series. Please see [Registration and Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaQualifierDaeguA2024#43887-registration-and-payment-details) tab for registration fee information. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM1NTU5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3a118b424e278701313a1719599eeb8de50cc7ef/Screenshot_2025-10-20_at_8.56.54_PM.png) ### **대한민국 국적이 아닌 선수분들께서는 Korean Championship 2025에 참가 신청을 삼가주시기를 정중히 부탁드립니다.** Korean Championship은 대한민국에서 열리는 가장 중요한 WCA 대회입니다. 본 대회는 대한민국 챔피언을 선발하기 위한 대회인 만큼, 챔피언 타이틀이 대한민국 국적자에게 주어지기를 희망합니다. 다른 대회에는 언제든지 참가를 환영합니다. 모든 종목의 결승 라운드에서는 대한민국 참가자를 위해 결승 라운드 참가 인원의 50% 또는 8명 중 더 적은 수가 우선 배정됩니다. 우선 배정이 적용되는 라운드에서는, 이전 라운드에서 진출하는 참가자 중 대한민국 참가자가 먼저 선발되며, 이후 다른 국적의 상위 참가자가 선발됩니다. 모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. --- ### **The organization team kindly asks international competitors NOT to register for Korean Championship 2025.** Korean Championship is the most important WCA competition in Korea. As this competition is held to determine the national champion, we hope that the championship title will be awarded to competitors with Korean nationality. You are always welcome to participate in other competitions. For the final round of all events, 50% or up to 8 of the finalist spots (whichever is smaller) will be reserved for competitors representing the Republic of Korea. In rounds with reserved spots, advancing competitors will first include the top Korean competitors from the previous round, followed by the highest-ranked competitors of other nationalities. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). According to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must perform staff duties upon request from the organizers.

items.information: **This is a 24 hour competition!** As such it won't be very newcomer and kid friendly, so please keep that in mind. Make sure that you are active on your WCA email account. items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Kristiansund Open 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KristiansundOpen2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KristiansundOpen2025#61112-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Kristiansund Open 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for this competition. We strongly advise all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KristiansundOpen2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KristiansundOpen2025#61112-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

items.information: This competition, Krungthep Farewell 2024, is organised by ThailandCube to bid farewell to the old year and celebrate the new year. We hope that all attendees, whether as a competitor or a spectator, enjoy the competition and return with good memories for years to come! การแข่งขันนี้ ในชื่อของ "Krungthep Farewell 2024" ถูกจัดขึ้นโดยชมรมลูกบาศก์ไทย เพื่อส่งท้ายปีเก่า และต้อนรับปีใหม่ โดยการแข่งขันครั้งนี้จัดขึ้นเป็นปีที่ 3 แล้ว นับตั้งแต่ปี 2022 เราหวังว่าทุกคนที่มีส่วนร่วม ไม่ว่าจะเป็นในฐานะผู้เข้าแข่งขันหรือผู้เข้าชมจะได้รับประสบการณ์ที่ดีกลับไปครับ! **As this competition does not include the 3x3x3 Cube event, we do not recommend this competition to those who do not have experience in speedcubing competitons.** **การแข่งขันนี้ไม่มีแข่งประเภท 3x3x3 ทางคณะผู้จัดไม่แนะนำสำหรับผู้เข้าแข่งขันใหม่** **For additional information, please see other tabs. สำหรับข้อมูลอื่น ๆ สามารถดูได้ในช่องแท็บ** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDYwMDksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7b61ca8e1e12680142e99c4b76473b5b40136e37/005%20KTFW2024%20(for%20Website).png)

items.information: **Português** O KubeKids é o 10º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - No momento da premiação, no final do domingo, vamos sortear alguns cubos para os competidores. Só ganha quem estiver presente e ninguém pode ganhar duas vezes; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** KubeKids is the 10th Official Championship of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: 🇧🇷 O Kube Kids Vila Velha 2023 é o 16º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Estamos ansiosos para recebê-los e queremos compartilhar algumas dicas importantes para os competidores e acompanhantes: - Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA assim que o pagamento for confirmado e o comprovante for enviado. Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KubeKidsVilaVelha2023/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em que você irá participar; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! Se você tiver alguma dúvida, fique à vontade para perguntar; - Se este for o seu primeiro campeonato, assista a [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Antes da competição, leia as [Regulamentações da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) para estar familiarizado com as regras; - Divirta-se e aproveite ao máximo! ------------------------------------- 🇺🇸 Kube Kids Vila Velha 2023 is the 16th Official Espírito Santo Competition. We are excited to welcome you and want to share some essential tips for competitors and companions: - Your registration will be confirmed on the WCA website as soon as the payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent. For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KubeKidsVilaVelha2023/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! If you have any questions, feel free to ask; - If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Before the competition, read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) to become familiar with the rules; - Have fun and make the most of the experience! ------------------------------------- #### Organização/Organization: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc1JMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--21d308c05a84a509a0a5091b9aae85d06e9b68c7/speedcubes-logo-0.25x.png)
